claims.claim: Stem's structural role is software/control optimization between distributed energy assets and grid/customer needs; dispatch and asset management can raise utilization without owning the underlying energy resource.
A software/services mix can improve capital efficiency only if recurring demand and retention replace declining hardware revenue.

factors.name: alignment2036
factors.basis: Optimization can improve utilization of distributed storage/renewables.

factors.name: scenarioRobustness
factors.basis: Software mix reduces hardware exposure but transition credibility depends on recurring conversion and cash durability.

risks.risk: Hardware retreat without sufficient recurring software conversion can shrink scale and cash generation.

causalEdges.mechanism: more distributed assets increase dispatch and asset-management complexity
causalEdges.falsifier: OEM-native/in-house controls displace third-party optimization or recurring demand fails to grow

causalEdges.mechanism: forecasting and dispatch can improve operating outcomes
causalEdges.falsifier: customer retention/conversion fails to validate economic value

unknowns.unknown: Organic versus acquired ARR contribution and recurring backlog conversion economics.

claims.claim: Declining total revenue and continuing net loss make the software-mix transition an execution test rather than a completed turnaround.
Adjusted EBITDA improvement can overstate economic progress unless recurring growth and cash flow remain durable.

factors.name: financialOperatingMomentum
factors.basis: Margin/bookings improvement coexists with lower revenue and negative GAAP earnings.

factors.name: confidenceInflation
factors.basis: Adjusted profitability requires confirmation in GAAP/cash outcomes.

risks.risk: Liquidity/financing and competitive substitution can constrain the transition.

causalEdges.mechanism: shrinking legacy contribution must be replaced by recurring software economics
causalEdges.falsifier: recurring software growth, retention and cash generation sustainably offset the decline

contradictions.claim: Improving margins/bookings coexist with declining total revenue.
contradictions.resolution: Consistent with a mix transition, but remains a material execution test until recurring growth and cash durability are demonstrated.

unknowns.unknown: Backlog conversion timing, recurring margin, customer concentration and cash-flow durability.
